verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.mixpanel.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown versions of the doc pages. Many cited doc pages are served as clean .md URLs (e.g., /docs/mcp.md, /docs/export-methods.md), which gives agents directly consumable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent-specific docs bundle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using the llms.txt.
